summary: Main per-frame update for a UI scroll widget. When the enable flag at this+0xEC is set, reads the input delta pair via DualFieldRead, dispatches virtual calls to fetch the current position (vtable+24) and its lower/upper scroll bounds (vtable+28 and vtable+36), sets the active/in-range flag at this+0xED when the delta lies inside those bounds, runs DeltaBasedUpdate, and finally, if the widget is not hidden (vtable+152 returns false), dispatches a notify call (vtable+44, arg 1) and runs the extra widget update sub_486600.

operations.description: Guard on the enable flag at this+0xEC; when it is zero the entire update body is skipped and the function returns 0.
Call DualFieldRead(v6, &v5) to read the input delta pair backing the scroll position range data at obj+0x2C.
Dispatch the vtable entry at obj+0x18 (vtable+24) with no argument to update the current position.
Dispatch the vtable entry at obj+0x1C (vtable+28) and store its return as the low scroll bound.
Dispatch the vtable entry at obj+0x24 (vtable+36) and store its return as the high scroll bound.
Range check: only when the delta v5 is greater than or equal to the low bound and less than or equal to the high bound is the widget considered in-range.
Set the active/in-range flag at this+0xED to 1 when the delta is within the scroll bounds.
Call DeltaBasedUpdate(this) to process scroll delta changes.
Hidden check: dispatch vtable entry at obj+0x98 (vtable+152); when it returns false (not hidden) the notify path runs.
Dispatch the vtable entry at vtable+44 with argument 1 to notify the widget of the visible state.
Call sub_486600(this), the additional widget update step for the not-hidden path.
Return 0 at the end of the guarded body and when the enable flag is clear.
